use: Project-owned prototype character surface textures for the Unity iOS vertical slice.

files.name: wuming_ceramic
files.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: seamless production game material albedo texture for a low-poly iOS Unity hero, named Wuming
Primary request: a bold, highly readable aged ceramic armor surface: pale limestone-white glaze broken into broad irregular fired plates, visible dark charcoal chips and binding shadows expressed only as color, sparse hairline craquelure, ash abrasion, and restrained surviving mineral pigments in faded cinnabar red and ochre. The pigment should form broken painterly bands and fragments, never letters or symbols. It must look distinctive even when the character is only 100 pixels tall.
Style/medium: premium hand-painted PBR albedo, stylized historical fantasy, late-sixth-century northern Chinese stone-statue and kiln-fired ceramic mood, painterly clarity similar to a polished mobile action game
Composition/framing: perfectly flat orthographic square material filling the canvas, broad macro variation plus medium detail, seamless and tileable on all four edges
Lighting/mood: neutral diffuse base color only; absolutely no directional light, cast shadow, ambient occlusion, highlight, reflection, or vignette
Color palette: warm ivory, limestone grey, charcoal chips, faded cinnabar, muted ochre, tiny cold blue-grey ash accents
Constraints: strong mobile readability; seamless repeat; no object silhouette; no armor shape; no face; no human body; no text; no watermark; no logo; no decorative emblem; no modern pattern; clean usable albedo
Avoid: plain beige stone, uniform noise, marble, glossy porcelain, white studio highlights, photoreal object photography, Japanese motifs, dragons, runes, calligraphy, mosaics, deep black voids
